name: @forge/contracts
description: Shared types and runtime tables for core and web-v2: row and request types derived from @forge/core, and the vocabularies both read at runtime (permissions, outbox consumers, pipeline registry). Each module is its own subpath, @forge/contracts/<module>.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.emit.json --noCheck && node scripts/check-exports.mjs
